items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: SPEAKER_03 mentions: 'how he and Mr. Celestan they used to alternate you know... Celestan had the original Tuxilla and he had the Maple Leaf band.' The interviewee (Clarence Vincent) is the 'me' in the speaker's story, but the relationship described is between 'he' (likely the interviewee's father o

ctx.x: Tell them more about when they used to shoot the lights out in the dance hall. They get drunk and they have a gun on them. Just put it out and shoot. There are so many people there and the police will be on them and they get scared.

They used to play, they used to sing with me when he'd come home and how he and Mr. Celestan they used to alternate you know. Celestan had the original Tuxilla and he had the Maple Leaf band. And they used to buck against one another. And from what I can understand it was the only two bands in New Orleans outside of Pierron. I mean Pierron was in a different class altogether. He was in a high society class. And the original Tuxillas and the Maple Leaf they had their class. And sometimes they used to alternate.…
